body: Magandang psychological frame, pero trend hat muna: one CAA warning is evidence na may problem, hindi pa evidence na accelerating ang problem. Para tawaging rising pattern, gusto ko ng consultation counts over time, repeated warnings, or independent enforcement/bank data. Otherwise baka napagkamalan nating trend ang spotlight. One flashlight does not mean dumami ang ipis; minsan ngayon lang natin tinutukan.

claims.text: The cited Consumer Affairs Agency warning establishes the existence of recovery-scam risk but, by itself, is insufficient to establish that incidence is increasing over time.
claims.basis: Trend inference boundary: a time trend requires longitudinal or repeated independent evidence beyond a single warning.
